programme.title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly
programme.sub-title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly | Full EPISODE | Wednesday, June 3, 2026
programme.desc: A new report says many abortion businesses are violating federal rules designed to protect women. Charlotte Lozier Institute says more than a half-dozen online abortion businesses are shipping abortion drugs into states with pro-life laws prohibiting their distribution. The group also says more than 80% of abortion drug sellers make the dangerous drugs available after 10 weeks of pregnancy, flouting FDA guidelines. Charlotte Lozier Institute’s Dr. Ingrid Skop says the study reveals major concerns, and little oversight from the FDA. Plus, Pope Leo delivers pro-family and pro-motherhood messages to a group of lawmakers from the European Parliament. He also ties in the continent’s demographic struggles with Europe’s shift toward anti-Christian policies. Dr. Joseph Meaney from the National Catholic Bioethics Center goes inside the numbers on Europe’s aging population and its increase in both abortion and euthanasia. Several U.S. states push back on so-called “Pride Month” by inaugurating pro-family and pro-life initiatives for June. And how the National Shrine of Our Lady of Champion in Wisconsin is celebrating America’s upcoming 250th anniversary with a Catholic twist.

programme.title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly
programme.sub-title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly | Full EPISODE | Wednesday, June 3, 2026
programme.desc: A new report says many abortion businesses are violating federal rules designed to protect women. Charlotte Lozier Institute says more than a half-dozen online abortion businesses are shipping abortion drugs into states with pro-life laws prohibiting their distribution. The group also says more than 80% of abortion drug sellers make the dangerous drugs available after 10 weeks of pregnancy, flouting FDA guidelines. Charlotte Lozier Institute’s Dr. Ingrid Skop says the study reveals major concerns, and little oversight from the FDA. Plus, Pope Leo delivers pro-family and pro-motherhood messages to a group of lawmakers from the European Parliament. He also ties in the continent’s demographic struggles with Europe’s shift toward anti-Christian policies. Dr. Joseph Meaney from the National Catholic Bioethics Center goes inside the numbers on Europe’s aging population and its increase in both abortion and euthanasia. Several U.S. states push back on so-called “Pride Month” by inaugurating pro-family and pro-life initiatives for June. And how the National Shrine of Our Lady of Champion in Wisconsin is celebrating America’s upcoming 250th anniversary with a Catholic twist.

programme.title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly
programme.sub-title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly | Full EPISODE | Wednesday, June 3, 2026
programme.desc: A new report says many abortion businesses are violating federal rules designed to protect women. Charlotte Lozier Institute says more than a half-dozen online abortion businesses are shipping abortion drugs into states with pro-life laws prohibiting their distribution. The group also says more than 80% of abortion drug sellers make the dangerous drugs available after 10 weeks of pregnancy, flouting FDA guidelines. Charlotte Lozier Institute’s Dr. Ingrid Skop says the study reveals major concerns, and little oversight from the FDA. Plus, Pope Leo delivers pro-family and pro-motherhood messages to a group of lawmakers from the European Parliament. He also ties in the continent’s demographic struggles with Europe’s shift toward anti-Christian policies. Dr. Joseph Meaney from the National Catholic Bioethics Center goes inside the numbers on Europe’s aging population and its increase in both abortion and euthanasia. Several U.S. states push back on so-called “Pride Month” by inaugurating pro-family and pro-life initiatives for June. And how the National Shrine of Our Lady of Champion in Wisconsin is celebrating America’s upcoming 250th anniversary with a Catholic twist.

programme.title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly
programme.sub-title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly | Full EPISODE | Wednesday, June 3, 2026
programme.desc: A new report says many abortion businesses are violating federal rules designed to protect women. Charlotte Lozier Institute says more than a half-dozen online abortion businesses are shipping abortion drugs into states with pro-life laws prohibiting their distribution. The group also says more than 80% of abortion drug sellers make the dangerous drugs available after 10 weeks of pregnancy, flouting FDA guidelines. Charlotte Lozier Institute’s Dr. Ingrid Skop says the study reveals major concerns, and little oversight from the FDA. Plus, Pope Leo delivers pro-family and pro-motherhood messages to a group of lawmakers from the European Parliament. He also ties in the continent’s demographic struggles with Europe’s shift toward anti-Christian policies. Dr. Joseph Meaney from the National Catholic Bioethics Center goes inside the numbers on Europe’s aging population and its increase in both abortion and euthanasia. Several U.S. states push back on so-called “Pride Month” by inaugurating pro-family and pro-life initiatives for June. And how the National Shrine of Our Lady of Champion in Wisconsin is celebrating America’s upcoming 250th anniversary with a Catholic twist.

programme.title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly
programme.sub-title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly | Full EPISODE | Wednesday, June 3, 2026
programme.desc: A new report says many abortion businesses are violating federal rules designed to protect women. Charlotte Lozier Institute says more than a half-dozen online abortion businesses are shipping abortion drugs into states with pro-life laws prohibiting their distribution. The group also says more than 80% of abortion drug sellers make the dangerous drugs available after 10 weeks of pregnancy, flouting FDA guidelines. Charlotte Lozier Institute’s Dr. Ingrid Skop says the study reveals major concerns, and little oversight from the FDA. Plus, Pope Leo delivers pro-family and pro-motherhood messages to a group of lawmakers from the European Parliament. He also ties in the continent’s demographic struggles with Europe’s shift toward anti-Christian policies. Dr. Joseph Meaney from the National Catholic Bioethics Center goes inside the numbers on Europe’s aging population and its increase in both abortion and euthanasia. Several U.S. states push back on so-called “Pride Month” by inaugurating pro-family and pro-life initiatives for June. And how the National Shrine of Our Lady of Champion in Wisconsin is celebrating America’s upcoming 250th anniversary with a Catholic twist.

programme.title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly
programme.sub-title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly | Full EPISODE | Wednesday, June 3, 2026
programme.desc: A new report says many abortion businesses are violating federal rules designed to protect women. Charlotte Lozier Institute says more than a half-dozen online abortion businesses are shipping abortion drugs into states with pro-life laws prohibiting their distribution. The group also says more than 80% of abortion drug sellers make the dangerous drugs available after 10 weeks of pregnancy, flouting FDA guidelines. Charlotte Lozier Institute’s Dr. Ingrid Skop says the study reveals major concerns, and little oversight from the FDA. Plus, Pope Leo delivers pro-family and pro-motherhood messages to a group of lawmakers from the European Parliament. He also ties in the continent’s demographic struggles with Europe’s shift toward anti-Christian policies. Dr. Joseph Meaney from the National Catholic Bioethics Center goes inside the numbers on Europe’s aging population and its increase in both abortion and euthanasia. Several U.S. states push back on so-called “Pride Month” by inaugurating pro-family and pro-life initiatives for June. And how the National Shrine of Our Lady of Champion in Wisconsin is celebrating America’s upcoming 250th anniversary with a Catholic twist.

programme.title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly
programme.sub-title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly | Full EPISODE | Wednesday, June 3, 2026
programme.desc: A new report says many abortion businesses are violating federal rules designed to protect women. Charlotte Lozier Institute says more than a half-dozen online abortion businesses are shipping abortion drugs into states with pro-life laws prohibiting their distribution. The group also says more than 80% of abortion drug sellers make the dangerous drugs available after 10 weeks of pregnancy, flouting FDA guidelines. Charlotte Lozier Institute’s Dr. Ingrid Skop says the study reveals major concerns, and little oversight from the FDA. Plus, Pope Leo delivers pro-family and pro-motherhood messages to a group of lawmakers from the European Parliament. He also ties in the continent’s demographic struggles with Europe’s shift toward anti-Christian policies. Dr. Joseph Meaney from the National Catholic Bioethics Center goes inside the numbers on Europe’s aging population and its increase in both abortion and euthanasia. Several U.S. states push back on so-called “Pride Month” by inaugurating pro-family and pro-life initiatives for June. And how the National Shrine of Our Lady of Champion in Wisconsin is celebrating America’s upcoming 250th anniversary with a Catholic twist.

programme.sub-title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly | Full EPISODE | Wednesday, June 3, 2026
programme.desc: A new report says many abortion businesses are violating federal rules designed to protect women. Charlotte Lozier Institute says more than a half-dozen online abortion businesses are shipping abortion drugs into states with pro-life laws prohibiting their distribution. The group also says more than 80% of abortion drug sellers make the dangerous drugs available after 10 weeks of pregnancy, flouting FDA guidelines. Charlotte Lozier Institute’s Dr. Ingrid Skop says the study reveals major concerns, and little oversight from the FDA. Plus, Pope Leo delivers pro-family and pro-motherhood messages to a group of lawmakers from the European Parliament. He also ties in the continent’s demographic struggles with Europe’s shift toward anti-Christian policies. Dr. Joseph Meaney from the National Catholic Bioethics Center goes inside the numbers on Europe’s aging population and its increase in both abortion and euthanasia. Several U.S. states push back on so-called “Pride Month” by inaugurating pro-family and pro-life initiatives for June. And how the National Shrine of Our Lady of Champion in Wisconsin is celebrating America’s upcoming 250th anniversary with a Catholic twist.

programme.sub-title: Madre Teresa y el amor a los demás

En cuanto llegan al lugar, todos tienen miedo porque no saben cómo ayudar y acompañar a los viejos amigos que viven ahí. Es entonces cuando llega la hora de contar la historia de Madre Teresa de Calcuta, una Santa que le pedía a Dios que la ayudara a tener un corazón grande para poder amar y ayudar a mucha gente. La historia cambia totalmente la vida de esos pececitos, tanto que regresan al arrecife y descubren un tesoro que solo pueden encontrar con actos de amor.

programme.desc: El Padre Pénès Célestin, es un sacerdote comprometido con un proyecto de becas para huérfanos a causa de los desastres naturales que han marcado la historia reciente de su país. Él compartirá su testimonio, el contexto de Haití, la violencia que enfrenta el pueblo haitiano, y cómo su vocación y su labor pastoral se han visto marcadas por los momentos más dolorosos de su país.

programme.title: Madre Ursula Micaela Morata
programme.desc: Este documental muestra la vida de Sor Úrsula Micaela Morata, quien funda el Convento de las Clarisas Capuchinas de Alicante, España. Tuvo un profundo amor por la Eucaristía y una estrecha relación y amor por la Virgen.

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica
programme.desc: La Solemnidad del Cuerpo y la Sangre de Cristo (o Corpus Christi) celebra la presencia real de Jesucristo en la Eucaristía. ¿Crees tú en los milagros? El Padre Pedro nos exhorta a creer de verdad que en cada Misa, el pan y el vino se convierten verdaderamente en el Cuerpo y la Sangre del Señor.
